data.title: 诗怀雅 · 扇子后的一笑
data.description: 她用折扇半掩笑意，倾身问你有没有听清邀请，等你的视线落到她脸上才缓缓合扇。
data.action: 折扇半掩，俯身挑眉看向镜头
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: In a luxurious banquet ballroom, Swire leans forward across a linen-clad table, playfully concealing her smile behind a painted silk folding fan. Her sharp, calculating golden eyes and raised brow gaze intently at the viewer beneath glittering crystal chandeliers.
data.animaCaption: Peeking over the edge of her painted silk fan, she arches an eyebrow at the viewer, challenging them to guess her next move.
